process_findings.title: FINAL_REPORT.md was rewritten in place during this audit session, invalidating part of the requested §6 cross-check and changing MPC's classification underneath the sample
process_findings.detail: This session first read FINAL_REPORT.md §6 early in the audit: a 15-name satellite (incl. RL, HAS, MPC as holding #5 at 5.8% weight, INCLUDE-SMALL) with REIT names (HST, FRT) priced on plain 'NTM P/E' (HST 19.7x, matching d4_live_snapshot.parquet's pe_ntm=19.66 exactly), and an excluded-names list ending '...COP...; AIZ...' that did NOT include MPC. Re-reading the identical file near the end of this session (file mtime 2026-09-26 07:53:32, i.e. after this session began) shows a DIFFERENT §6: a 12-name satellite + an explicit 30% S&P-500-index-fund row (RL, HAS and MPC no longer holdings), REIT names now priced on 'P/FFO' (HST 8.5x, FRT 10.8x -- a metric with no corresponding field in data\d4_live_snapshot.parquet), and an excluded-names list that now DOES include MPC ('MPC (own valuation base case -17%/yr)') and ends at COP with per-name base-case percentages throughout. The task brief for this audit named MPC as one of '4 excluded near-miss names' -- true for the version that existed by the end of this session, false for the version that existed for most of it (including when the MPC dossier itself, still written as an INCLUDE-SMALL half-weight holding, was read).
process_findings.why_it_matters: (1) An audit needs a stable, point-in-time snapshot of the document it is checking; a live in-place rewrite during the audit window means different auditors (or the same auditor at different times) can reach different, both-technically-correct answers about the same claim. (2) The new HST/FRT 'P/FFO' figures are not traceable to the named source-of-record file (data\d4_live_snapshot.parquet), which is itself a data-integrity gap regardless of whether the new figures are right. (3) This appears to run against this workspace's own CLAUDE.md convention ('Publish through the shared release tool with an explicit parent version and change log. Do not overwrite an older release or silently promote a draft to the current recommendation') -- if this rewrite is a draft in progress rather than a logged, versioned release, readers (and other agents) currently see it as the live FINAL_REPORT.md with no changelog entry visible to this session.
process_findings.recommendation: Flag to the lead/orchestrator immediately: confirm whether the 12-name+index-fund/P/FFO version is an intentional, ready-to-publish revision (in which case it should go through versions/catalog.json with a parent version and change log per CLAUDE.md) or an in-progress draft that should not have been saved over the live FINAL_REPORT.md while audits were reading it. Either way, the MPC dossier (still INCLUDE-SMALL, written for the old structure) and the HST/FRT valuation figures need a reconciliation pass before the next loop treats §6 as settled.
